headline: Chinese Vice Premier Holds Video Call with US Officials
summary: Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng held a video call with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss economic and trade matters.
why: High-level bilateral communications between the world's largest economies help set the trajectory for trade policies, tariffs, and cross-border commercial relations.

impacts.name: China
impacts.why: Bilateral trade talks influence macroeconomic sentiment and regulatory expectations for international trade.
